name: create_harness
description: Create and run a sub-harness (multi-agent session). Runs to completion and returns results. Use initial_message to provide the task for the sub-harness.

initial_message.description: The task/message to send to the sub-harness. Required for harness with input nodes.

inherit_conversation.description: If true, sub-harness starts with current conversation history

return_mode.description: 'all' returns entire conversation, 'last' returns only final message
